title: Measure what additional annotation would resolve section-hand confounding
question: Which underrepresented combinations of section and source-specific hand labels would best distinguish competing explanations?
rationale: A map of missing combinations can direct limited manual annotation to useful evidence instead of collecting more of the same examples.
distinctness: An annotation-priority proposal, separate from re-running a cluster algorithm or treating its labels as truth.

prior_work_check.scope: Bounded launch-source catalog and current seed directions inspected; this does not establish world-first novelty.

first_step: Audit the existing label contingency table and list a bounded image sample with an explicit sampling rationale.
limitations: Candidate suggestion only; detailed protocol and execution are future work.
Designated seed: zero competitive allocations; evidence-tier baseline awaits official assessment.
attribution: voynich.win launch curation, AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex; exposed precise model version not recorded
